data.topic: How should the skill advisor surface slash commands (all 45 under .skilled/commands, not only /doctor) so a model either runs the matching command workflow by itself or asks the user first, and how does a request typed as plain chat with no slash command still reach the proper command workflow on every runtime? Work through ten research angles: inventory, scoring, output contract, run or ask, invocation mechanics, chat-only users, skill and command linkage, measurement, prior art, and failure modes.
